user.title: Hunch Home
user.description:
Hunch Home understands loosely worded home commands. The model runs in the Hunch Home server on your own machine, not in Home Assistant itself, so install that first: {server_page}. The model is inside the server, and no account is needed.

Hunch keeps a record of each sentence it handles and what it did, here in your Home Assistant, so you can see what went wrong. Nothing leaves your computer unless you choose to share it to make Hunch better. You can switch the record off or clear it under Configure.

data.ha_first: Let Home Assistant's own sentences answer first

data_description.url: The full HTTP or HTTPS address of the Hunch server, including its port.
data_description.secret: Only if your Hunch server asks for one, as it does when other machines on your network can reach it. Leave it empty for a server running as a Home Assistant app.
data_description.timeout: If the server takes longer than this, the sentence goes to Home Assistant's own agent.
data_description.ha_first: When on, a sentence Home Assistant understands exactly is carried out by Home Assistant, and Hunch is asked only about the rest.
data_description.locks_and_doors: Lets Hunch unlock a lock, and open and close a door, gate, garage door or motorised window, when the sentence names it. A command that names no device opens and closes only blinds, curtains and other window coverings. These commands are still being improved: in version 1.1's test, both answers were right for 57.7% of 52 real commands about locks, doors and alarms. Switch it off to leave them to Home Assistant's own sentences.

reauth_missing.title: The Hunch server needs a secret
reauth_missing.description: The Hunch server turned Hunch Home away because no shared secret is set. Enter the secret your server was set up with. Until you do, every sentence goes to Home Assistant's own agent.

reauth_wrong.title: The Hunch server refused the secret
reauth_wrong.description: The Hunch server turned away the shared secret Hunch Home sent: it does not match the server's. Enter the secret your server was set up with. Until you do, every sentence goes to Home Assistant's own agent.

init.title: Hunch Home
init.description: Hunch keeps a record of each sentence it handles and what it did, here in your Home Assistant. Nothing leaves your computer unless you choose to share it to make Hunch better.

record.title: The record
record.description: For each sentence, the record keeps when it was said, the words, Hunch's answer, what the plug-in did, and whether you or someone else put it back within 30 seconds. It keeps the latest 1,000 sentences, none older than 30 days, in this Home Assistant only. See it with the action Hunch Home: Show the record.

data_description.record: Switched off, nothing new is kept. What is already kept stays until you clear it.

record_and_sharing.description: For each sentence, the record keeps when it was said, the words, Hunch's answer, what the plug-in did, and whether you or someone else put it back within 30 seconds. It keeps the latest 1,000 sentences, none older than 30 days, in this Home Assistant only. See it with the action Hunch Home: Show the record.

data.share_counts: Share daily counts to make Hunch better

data_description.record: Switched off, nothing new is kept. What is already kept stays until you clear it.
data_description.share_counts: Nothing leaves your computer unless you choose to share it to make Hunch better. This is off unless you turn it on, and Hunch Home works just the same without it. Once a day it sends counts only: how many sentences of each kind, what the plug-in did with them, how many were put back, rough scores, the version numbers and an install number made at random for this alone. Never anything you say or type, and no device names or rooms. Download diagnostics to see exactly what would be sent. Turn it off and nothing more is sent, and what this home sent is deleted. Privacy notice: {notice}. Questions: {contact}.

clear_record.title: Clear the record
clear_record.description: This deletes every sentence and everything else in the record from this Home Assistant. It cannot be undone.

abort.not_loaded: Hunch Home is not running. Start it again, then try once more.
abort.not_offered: Sharing is not available in this version.

show_record.name: Show the record
show_record.description: Shows everything Hunch Home has kept: each sentence, Hunch's answer, what the plug-in did and whether it was put back. It stays in your Home Assistant.
